import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        String inp = scanner.nextLine();

        // Replace first occurrence of 'at' with '@'
        int indexAt = inp.indexOf("at");
        if (indexAt != -1) {
            inp = inp.substring(0, indexAt) + "@" + inp.substring(indexAt + 2);
        }

        // Replace all 'dot' with '.'
        inp = inp.replace("dot", ".");

        // Check if string starts with '.'
        if (inp.startsWith(".")) {
            inp = "dot" + inp.substring(1);
        }

        // Check if string starts with '@'
        if (inp.startsWith("@")) {
            int atIndex = inp.indexOf("at");
            if (atIndex != -1) {
                inp = inp.substring(0, atIndex) + "@" + inp.substring(atIndex + 2);
            }
            inp = "at" + inp.substring(1);
        }

        // Check if string ends with '.'
        if (inp.endsWith(".")) {
            inp = inp.substring(0, inp.length() - 1) + "dot";
        }

        System.out.println(inp);
        scanner.close();
    }
}
